explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the subject of the entire chapter's discussion on honor, sacrifice, and love.
A place where God dwells among his people, central to Jesus' conflict with religious leaders.
The holy chest in the temple where money was collected for God's house and the poor.
A woman who has lost her husband; a symbol of vulnerability, but also of sincere devotion when she gave all she had.
People chosen by God to bring his message throughout history, often persecuted and killed.
The title used for Jesus showing respect for his teaching authority in dialogue with the Pharisees.
The title of Jesus confirming his divine origin and authority before the religious leaders.
The greatest commandment to love God completely and your neighbor as yourself, summarizing the whole law.
